back: A line at 90° to a surface at the point where a ray meets it.
The angles between the incident ray (or reflected ray) and the normal.
Angle of incidence = angle of reflection (and both rays and the normal lie in one plane).
Same size, same distance behind the mirror, upright, virtual, laterally inverted.
An image that light only appears to come from; it cannot be formed on a screen.

front: How do you locate the image of a point in a plane mirror?
back: On the normal through the object, as far behind the mirror as the object is in front; reflected rays traced back meet there.
